# Mr & Mrs Lifestyle

> Mr & Mrs Lifestyle is a Dubai-based personal training and online fitness coaching business run by husband-and-wife coaches Tarek Elzamek and Chloe Antoniazzi. Tarek offers 1-to-1 personal training at Nogs Gym, Al Quoz; Chloe offers private, ladies-only reformer Pilates plus strength training on a Speediance Gym Monster 3 smart machine at The Pilates Room, Meydan; both offer online coaching for clients in the UAE and worldwide, specialising in fat loss, muscle gain, body recomposition, women's glute training, pre/postnatal fitness and couples coaching.

Key facts:
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In-person sessions: personal training with Tarek at Nogs Gym (men and women), and private reformer Pilates with Chloe at The Pilates Room by Chloe, Meydan Avenue, Block A, Shop 3, Meydan (ladies only, private sessions, babies welcome, free parking; website thepilatesroombychloe.com).
- Coaches: Tarek Elzamek (strength and transformation specialist, 10+ years coaching) and Chloe Antoniazzi (women's, glutes and pre/postnatal specialist; mat, ball and reformer Pilates instructor).
- Online coaching prices: Economy Pack AED 299/month (ready-made 4-week beginner programme, not personalised, email support, no coach check-ins), Elite Coaching Experience AED 899/month (personalised training and nutrition, weekly check-in call, WhatsApp 24/7), VIP Online Coaching AED 1,999/month (Elite plus a video session every 2 weeks and priority WhatsApp), Couples Transformation AED 1,499/month for both (personalised plan for each partner, shared check-in every 2 weeks, WhatsApp). Specialist programmes are self-guided with email support and no coach check-ins. Specialist programmes: Booty Builder AED 649/month, Ultimate Muscle Gain AED 480/month, Ultimate Fat Burn AED 480/month, Tailor-Made Nutrition Plan AED 750/month. Every package except the Economy Pack (Elite, VIP, Couples and all specialist programmes) is a 12-week programme billed monthly for 3 months that ends automatically. The Economy Pack is a monthly subscription that renews automatically until cancelled with 14 days' notice before the renewal date. Payments are non-refundable; full policy at https://www.mrandmrslifestyle.com/terms.html#subscription-policy. Economy includes email support; Elite, VIP and Couples include WhatsApp access to your coach.
- 1-to-1 personal training in Dubai: Tarek only, 12 and 20-session packages at Nogs Gym. Chloe does not do gym personal training; she offers private, ladies-only reformer Pilates (single, 5, 10 and 20 sessions) at The Pilates Room, Meydan. Tarek's packages: 12 sessions AED 3,800, 20 sessions AED 5,500. Chloe's 1:1 private reformer sessions are AED 429 single, AED 2,145 for 5, AED 4,075 for 10, AED 7,290 for 20.
- Reviews: rated 5.0 from 33 Google reviews (Google Business Profile "Mr and Mrs Lifestyle Coaching": https://www.google.com/maps?cid=2909583114513034830).
- Clients follow their training programme, check-ins and progress tracking in the My PT Hub app.
- Free strategy call before signing up. Contact: WhatsApp Tarek +971 50 787 1515 (online coaching, Nogs Gym PT), WhatsApp Chloe +971 54 701 1995 (The Pilates Room, ladies-only reformer Pilates), info@mrandmrslifestyle.com.
